title: Two voices on our side: a team planning call

lines.text: Let us plan the launch week. What do we still need from design?
lines.name: Maya

lines.text: Design owes us the final icons and the empty states.
I can finish the icons by Wednesday if we freeze the color palette today.
lines.name: Omer

lines.text: We freeze the palette today, that is decided.
lines.name: Maya

lines.text: I will write the release notes and share them on Thursday.
How many testers can we get for the beta?
lines.name: Maya

lines.text: We have 40 testers signed up so far.
lines.name: Omer

lines.text: Is the payment flow tested on the old phones?
lines.name: Maya

lines.text: I will ask the QA team about the old phones and tell you tomorrow.
One worry: the launch week is also a holiday week for half of the support team.
lines.name: Maya

lines.text: I will talk to support about a rota before the end of the week.
lines.name: Omer
